audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's headline was "E her snips" — that Counter Strike answers Snip Snip!.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges incoming ATTACKS. Snip Snip! is an ability with true damage in the centre cone, so it lands through the dodge entirely. What Counter Strike does answer is the empowered basic attack she gets from Skip 'n Slash — that is the auto worth holding E for, and the stun catches her mid-dash before the cooldown refund lands.
audit.corrected: Headline, win condition, do's and Key Ability Interactions re-keyed to her Skip 'n Slash auto instead of her snips.

audit.whatIsWrong: No timers anywhere, and the level-6 row credited your Grandmaster stats.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 (18s at rank 5) — that is the window the whole lane is built around, and she does not have it until level 4. Skip 'n Slash is 13s with a partial refund on hit, and Needlework is 120s at rank 1. Level 6 is hers because of Needlework's range plus her passive healing, not yours.
audit.corrected: Mist's 22s, Skip 'n Slash's 13s-with-refund written into the cooldown block, the stage whys and Key Ability Interactions; level 6 rewritten as her stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were both marked Skill while the whys say you "out-trade a pre-item Gwen" at 4-5 and call 6 "Her spike".
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill/Jax/Jax/Jax/Gwen/Jax/Jax on a 55.36% matchup, agreeing with the prose. The mirror spotted the same two-row disagreement and flagged it without editing, so it falls to this side to fix.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 flipped to Jax and Level 6 to Gwen in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved to match.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Gwen's Hallowed Mist is down.
edits.after: Take W: Leap Strike into an Empowered auto out-bursts her lone dash before she has Hallowed Mist at all.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gwen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Counter Strike online — dodge her Skip 'n Slash auto, stun her, and chunk a Gwen with no mist yet to escape into.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Hallowed Mist's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your combo cooldowns drop and she has no items yet — engage on her Skip 'n Slash timer while Hallowed Mist (22s) is down.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gwen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Her level: Needlework pokes you from range and her passive heals back much of what she lands, so keep every trade short.

edits.before: E her snips — fight when her W mist is down. Jax wins by trading around Gwen's Hallowed Mist and cashing the pattern: e her snips and fight off her mist.
edits.after: E her dash auto, not her snips — fight when the mist drops. Jax wins by trading around Gwen's Hallowed Mist and cashing the pattern: bait W, then all-in.

edits.before: E her snips and fight off her mist. Track Hallowed Mist before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: E her Skip 'n Slash auto and fight off her mist. Snip Snip! is an ability — your dodge never touches it.

edits.before: E her snips — fight when her W mist is down.
edits.after: E her dash auto — fight when the mist drops.

edits.before: E her snips and fight off her mist. Track Hallowed Mist before every commit.
edits.after: E her dash auto, not her snips, and fight off her mist. Mist is 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: E to dodge her snip autos

- Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, and from outside it you cannot target her. Fight once it drops. - Skip 'n Slash: 13s, partly refunded on hit. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Gwen's Hallowed Mist: She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. When it is down — Q-E-W her.
edits.after: Track Hallowed Mist (22s): from outside it you cannot target her. Once it drops — Q-E-W her.

notes: Main correction: the full layer told you to Counter Strike her snips. Snip Snip! is an ability (true damage in the centre) and passes straight through the dodge; the auto worth holding E for is the empowered one off Skip 'n Slash. Chart: Levels 4-5 to Jax and Level 6 to Gwen, matching the packet and the page's own whys — the mirror flagged this pair and left it, so it is fixed here. UNVERIFIED and left alone: the page says A Thousand Cuts heals "70% of her damage" in three places (spikes[1].text, mid, wants.foe[1]); Riot's text says only "a portion", so the 70% figure is not confirmable from the kits.
